environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image on AWS Lambda with provisioned concurrency=1 behind API Gateway (REST API type). AWS Secrets Manager integration with automatic rotation Lambda configured at 60-second interval using custom rotation step function. The CredentialStore.getCurrentRotatingSecret() fetches from Secrets Manager cache with max_cache_age=45s. API Gateway has a request validator with body/parameter validation model that rejects requests containing JSESSIONID in query string parameters (defined via OpenAPI requestParameters constraint). Additionally, Lambda execution role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/SessionIntegrityBoundary) that denies secretsmanager:GetSecretValue unless aws:PrincipalTag/session-origin equals 'internal-generated'. The session-origin tag is only applied by the internal session generation path via STS session tags propagated from the OIDC provider federation. Cold-start instances get fresh empty ConcurrentHashMap, and provisioned concurrency=1 means the single instance is recycled every 55 seconds via a CloudWatch Events scheduled rule invoking UpdateFunctionConfiguration to force cold start.

config.request_parameter_validation: JSESSIONID query param rejected by OpenAPI model
